title: Tower coherence of the normalized rational tensor stage comparison
statement: Let l be prime, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_l, and W any scheme with l invertible in each residue field. Use the finite coefficient fields, rational constructible categories and normalized stage system of [lem-general-algebraically-closed-coefficient-stages]. For E ≤ L, conjugate the rational tensor scalar comparison of [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations] by the equalities from the recorded stage transitions to the actual scalar extension functors, giving rationalTensorStageComparison. These specific natural isomorphisms satisfy the bilinear coefficient-tower equation FamilyTower of [lem-pur-bilinear-comparison-coefficient-descent], with both input stage associators and the output stage associator. This statement constructs no common-stage quotient functor.

source.place: scalarOperationsOrdinary_tower, tensor clause, followed by completion conjugation and rationalization in the common-stage tensor argument of def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom

proof.text: Package each finite-field tensor tower in TensorTowerDatum. Its Coherent predicate is exactly the component equation. Apply rationalTensor_tower to the actual coefficient fields. The coefficient-inclusion composition equality and scalarAssociator_self identify the direct-inclusion datum with the composite-inclusion datum, proving tensorTowerDatum_coherent.

The cached stage datum is equal to the raw finite-field datum: their category structures and functor data agree definitionally. Transport Coherent along stageTensorDatum_eq before exposing any component compositions, obtaining stageTensor_tower. Identify the recorded stage associator using associator_existsUnique and the associator clause of stageSystem_existsUnique. Apply familyTower_of_transport to the transition and associator specifications; the equality transports cancel, yielding precisely FamilyTower for rationalTensorStageComparison.
